reply_text:
I answered Pree in a thread on her #central-team message: the site is Pine Crossing.

That comes from her own June 9 post in #central-team. The Pine Crossing morning receiver said the appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift, a driver who arrived at 7:10 was logged on a sticky note, and Hollis said he'd check the shift template. I found no later update in that channel.

The knowledge brain didn't return anything because its access token isn't tied to any member. To fix that, a brain-host admin needs to run `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <MEMBER>`.
